findings.title: `reasoning_effort` rejects "minimal", a value gpt-5 supports.
findings.body:
Linked issue #7053 asks for `reasoning_effort` support for gpt-5 models. gpt-5 accepts "minimal" as well as "low", "medium" and "high". This change allows only `Literal["low", "medium", "high"]`, both here in the Pydantic model and in the `CreateArguments` TypedDict at line 53.

Trigger: a config passed to `ChatCompletionClient.load_component` with `"reasoning_effort": "minimal"` fails with a `ValidationError`, so users still cannot pick the cheapest gpt-5 setting. The PR description says "minimal" is supported, but the code and the validation test (line 3341) both leave it out.

Fix: add "minimal" to both Literals and to the test's list of valid values.
